reasoning: Alaska’s statewide Cook Partisan Voting Index is R+6. Recent Alaska Senate polling in the last 45 days is mixed but competitive: one late-July/early-August survey found Mary Peltola ahead by 6 in the final round, while another August poll put her ahead by 1.6 points; a late-June Siena poll had Dan Sullivan ahead by 2. No reliable Alaska presidential general-election poll for the current cycle appeared in the gathered results, so the current race picture is driven by the Senate contest and is effectively a toss-up with a small Democratic edge in the most recent polling.
